correctness.rationale: The exact integer E8 root model produces A^2=32I+4A+24J and a tight-frame signed Gram S; spherical Gegenbauer addition then produces eigenvalue sectors of multiplicities (1,35,84) for even degrees and (8,112) for odd. Explicit generating-function coefficients yield the 0..10 rank list, including the degree-10 one-dimensional constant-sector loss. For all l>=11, the published explicit numerator bounds compared with D_l=C(l+5,5) show strict positivity: odd at l=11 and even at l=12, propagated by increasing D_l/(l+6)^2. Independently reconstructed all 240 coordinates and 120 representatives, checked graph quadratic identities and 49 rational exact-degree ranks through 48. The latter does not establish the infinite tail; the analytic inequality does.
